high_level_description: This image is a movie poster for the film "Due Occhi Diabolici," which translates to "Two Evil Eyes" in English. The poster features a striking and eerie design with a dark, almost black background that contrasts sharply with the bright blue lighting. People: The central figure on the poster is a man with pale skin and long, white hair. His eyes are glowing red, giving him a menacing and otherworldly appearance. He is wearing a dark, possibly leather, jacket, which adds to his sinister look.
